name: Poljanska Sora
subtitle: od jezu na Hotavljah do mostu na Logu nad Škofjo Loko

en.name: Poljanska Sora
en.subtitle: from the dam in Hotavlje to the bridge at the Log nad Škofjo Loko
en.description: Here, below Blegoš, the world lies like on a palm of your hand, about which the famous Slovene author dr. Ivan Tavčar already wrote. Here is nature, where one can breathe fully and relax while looking at the picturesque landscape, full of beauty and greenery. Here is the river Poljanska Sora with many pools and rapids, which adorns the valley with its flow and rich fish life.

description: Tu, pod Blegošem, se razprostira svet, o katerem je že pred 100 leti s posebno ljubeznijo pisal pisatelj dr. Ivan Tavčar. Tu je narava, kjer lahko človek polno zadiha in se spočije ob pogledih na slikovito pokrajino, polno lepot in zelenja. Tu je reka Poljanska Sora s številnimi tolmuni in brzicami, ki s svojim tokom in bogatim ribjim življem krasi dolino.
